thread:
alex.s: Heads up — prod Notify service 503s starting ~03:14 UTC. The metrics alert fired but the incident bot did NOT page the on-call. I see user reports too. Any idea if paging infra is down?

maria: seeing same. grafana shows sustained 5xx spike and alert rule triggered at 03:14. I checked the alert channel, no automated page.

jamie: I can confirm, I got the slack alert but no phone/pager notification. Tried to ack via /incident ack but nothing happened.

oncall-bot: Received alert for channel #incidents: notify-service (severity: P1). Attempting to route to on-call...

oncall-bot: Error: failed to deliver to paging provider (response: 401).

alex.s: 401 from paging provider — maybe auth token rotated? Who rotated pd creds recently?

pagerbridge-bot: webhook deliver failed. Payload post to https://pagerbridge.internal/v1/events returned 401 Unauthorized.

maria: Checking secrets manager now. I see a key rotation event in vault at 02:58 UTC for /secrets/pagerbridge/token by ops-automation. Might not have propagated to the bridge service.

jamie: Running a quick curl from our infra box to the bridge endpoint to reproduce:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $BRIDGE_TOKEN" -d '{"event":"test"}' https://pagerbridge.internal/v1/events
* HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
* {"error":"invalid_token","message":"token not recognized"}
```

alex.s: ok that matches. Looks like token in k8s secret != vault token (rotation mismatch). Can someone manually page on-call while we fix?

ops-phone: Manual page initiated to rotation on-call (phone). Called Jamie (on-call) at 03:22 UTC — reached voicemail then texted Slack fallback group.

jamie: got the manual call, on it. Investigating root cause for 503s now.

maria: Quick mitigation: I updated the deployment secret in namespace notify-prod with the latest vault token and restarted the pagerbridge pod (rolling restart).

pagerbridge-bot: Restart detected for deployment/pagerbridge (pod/pagerbridge-7f6b8 restarted). Re-attempting queued deliveries...

pagerbridge-bot: Delivery success for event id=evt_20240314_0314 -> routed to PagerDuty (incident created PD-12345).

oncall-bot: Page delivered to on-call at 03:30 UTC (via PagerDuty). Incident open.

alex.s: Good. For completeness, the notify-service 5xxs were due to a downstream cache flapping. Jamie is reverting a config change that caused cache misses.

jamie: rollback applied at 03:34 UTC — error rate dropping. Observability shows latency/5xx trending down.

maria: Follow-ups: 1) Add validation step to rotation job so it updates all targets (k8s secrets + bridge) atomically or retries on failure. 2) Add a canary check post-rotation: POST /health to bridge with new token and fail rotation if 401. 3) Add an alert for paging delivery failures (threshold e.g., >3 failed webhook deliveries in 5m).

alex.s: Agreed. Also logging gap — queued deliveries retried after restart but we had no visible alert that pages were queued and failing. That should be surfaced.

sre-rotation: Action items assigned: @maria to add post-rotation canary (priority P0), @ops-automation to update rotation playbook to write to both vault and k8s (P1), @eng-runtime to add delivery-failure alert (P1). Please add to incident board.

jamie: I'll draft a short customer-facing incident note: summary, timeline, impact (some customers missed pages for ~16 minutes), mitigation, and the follow-ups above. Posting to #incident-communications in a bit.

alex.s: Thanks all. Recording final notes here for postmortem: root cause = credential rotation race where bridge service did not get new token; secondary = no alerting for webhook auth failures; impact = delayed paging (manual paging required), partial customer impact for 16m.

oncall-bot: Incident tagged: "paging-delivery-delay". Closing thread for now; reopen if further escalations. :white_check_mark:
